summary_1line: After Krishna fails to secure peace, Vidura laments impending war and Kunti resolves to reveal Karna’s true birth to win him to the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kunti stands behind Karna on the Ganga’s bank as he prays facing the rising sun, her figure fading in the heat while his garments cast shade over her.
Karna, finishing his sun‑prayer with arms raised, turns in surprise to see Kunti standing silently behind him by the river.
Karna embraces Krishna beside the chariot before parting, both aware the coming war will likely end their lives.
